messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

there are still a few seats left for our online course on Sex Chromosome Evolution

 
Dates: 12?16 October 
 
Course website: [ https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/sexchr/ ]( https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/sexchr/ ) 
 
How do sex chromosomes evolve, and what can genomic and transcriptomic data tell us about their differentiation?
 
This hands-on online course will introduce practical approaches for identifying sex chromosomes and studying their evolution. Across five live sessions, we?ll work with genomic and transcriptomic data to explore recombination suppression, evolutionary strata, sex-biased gene expression, dosage compensation, gene gain and loss, and genome divergence.
 
The course combines short lectures with practical computational exercises using Linux command-line tools and R and Bioconductor. Participants will work with real datasets and learn how to analyse and interpret genomic patterns in an evolutionary context.
 
For the full list of our courses and workshops, please visit: [ https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/ ]( https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/ )
 
 
 
Best regards,
Carlo
